Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study involves three distinct proteomics datasets: a global proteome, an O-GlcNAcome (using GalNAz metabolic labeling and biotin enrichment), and an interactome (using AP-MS). Dimethyl labeling was explicitly used for the interactome (PXD039801). Acquisition mode (DDA vs DIA) is not explicitly stated, though 'Shotgun proteomics' and 'MaxQuant' are mentioned.

scope: The affinity purification of Flag-, HA-, or cMyc-tagged protein complexes was performed as previously reported using anti-Flag (M2, MilliporeSigma), anti-HA (Pierce), or anti-cMyc agarose (Pierce), respectively.

To efficiently capture the OGA protein complexes, especially the OGA substrates-associated PPIs, we inducibly expressed “substrate-trapping” versions of OGAs... along with affinity purification via N-terminal Flag-tag and C-terminal HA-tag, to detect OGA PPIs in cells.
Cells were induced to express Flag- and HA-tagged OGA WT/stalk domain mutant at low (B_1)and high (B_3) abundance follwed by affinity purification of OGA complexes.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material for the interactome (PXD039801) consisted of affinity-purified OGA protein complexes using Flag and HA tags.
